basics.name: Tanner Young
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: I graduated with a B.S. in Computer Science at the University of Hawaii at Manoa.

work.summary: Worked as Computer Operator at the Central Pacific Bank Operations Center
highlights: Processed payment documents containing sensitive information
Cut costs by digitizing logs that led to ~150 less papers printed per week
Improved efficiency and effectiveness of multiple bank processes

work.company: Applied Research Laboratory at the University of Hawaii
work.summary: Worked as computer science assistant under Noah Hafner, PhD
highlights: Gathered, logged, and parsed temperature, voltage, and GPS data at one second intervals using Python
Enabled for real-time data analysis for voltage drops, overheating, and locating assets in the field
Tested hardware components for compatibility with the LSTS toolchain

volunteer.summary: Allowed University of Hawaii students to create and join group fitness activities improving socialization and physical health among the student body
highlights: Utilized React, Meteor, Node.js, and MongoDB for full stack development
Worked in a team of four using issue-driven project management
Many functional and visually appealing webpages viewable at https://fitness-finder.github.io/
